hero.title: To the end of the world
hero.subtitle: Apostle Gabriel Olu Akintan is a man called and ordained to preach the gospel and bring men to Christ.
hero.verseText: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey everything that I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you always, to the end of the age.

aboutPreview: Apostle Gabriel Olu Akintan is the President and Founder of the HOUSE OF THE LORD EVANGELICAL AND PRAYER INTERNATIONAL CHURCH (HOLEPIC) in Warri, Delta State, Nigeria. He is an Apostle and Teacher of the Word with a deep commitment to preaching the gospel, bringing men to Christ, and raising kingdom-minded believers.

aboutSections.heading: Early Life & Call
aboutSections.body: Apostle Gabriel Olu Akintan was born and raised in Nigeria, where he experienced a profound encounter with the Lord at a young age. Called to serve God and preach the gospel, he began ministering as a young man and has remained committed to the work of the Kingdom.

aboutSections.heading: Ministry
aboutSections.body: Apostle Gabriel Olu Akintan is the President and Founder of the HOUSE OF THE LORD EVANGELICAL AND PRAYER INTERNATIONAL CHURCH (HOLEPIC). His ministry is focused on preaching the gospel, teaching the Word of God, prayer, evangelism, and leading people into a deeper relationship with Christ.

aboutSections.heading: Apostolic Calling
aboutSections.body: As an Apostle and Teacher of the Word, Apostle Gabriel Olu Akintan carries a strong passion for reaching people with the gospel and equipping believers for effective Christian living and service.

aboutSections.heading: Vision & Mission
aboutSections.body: The vision of the ministry is to take the gospel to the end of the world, win souls for Christ, establish believers in the faith, and raise a generation of people who are committed to the purposes of God.
